joinRule: A chargrp row joins an actor class only when every source names exactly one class for the row and that class names no other row.
A class names a row when its Mesh or SubMeshes default, own or inherited, is a body_mesh or face_mesh reference of the row.
A decoded table record names a row through such a reference or a chargrp index field, and a class through a string equal to an Engine.Pawn subclass export.
Candidates are never ranked by name likeness and one of several is never picked.
scriptSearchBound: Class defaults are read for the Engine.Pawn subclasses of every script package whose name table holds a chargrp mesh object name.
Then for every Engine.Pawn subclass whose export-table ancestry reaches a class that names a row.
A class default can name a mesh only through a name in its own package or through an ancestor class.
